NoTarget.label: Add a new gizmo "No Target" to hostile pawns
NoTarget.description: When enabled, this prevents colonists and turrets from auto-targeting the pawn. Enemy pawns that have relationships with colonists will be automatically marked as "No Target".

CaptureAsJob.label: Add a new gizmo "Capture" to capturable pawns
CaptureAsJob.description: When enabled, the pawn will be marked as available for capture. Colonists assigned with warden jobs will capture them automatically.
